output.one_liner: HubSpot is a customer relationship management (CRM) platform for managing sales, marketing, and customer service operations.

auth.notes: OAuth required for multi-account distribution; static auth bearer tokens for single account; developer API keys for specific features

evidence.snippet: OAuth is required for multiple accounts, while static auth access tokens are used for installing in a single account at a time.
Some app features and settings require a developer API key, which is available in the developer overview of your HubSpot account.
This access token is provided using the Bearer HTTP authorization header.

access.notes: Free developer account creation with sandbox access; app review required for production/marketplace distribution

evidence.snippet: Create a developer account in the HubSpot developer portal. HubSpot public apps must belong to a developer account.
The development overview in your HubSpot account provides a centralized page to manage apps, authentication details, app monitoring, app marketplace listings.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Rate limits vary by plan: Free/Starter 100 req/app/day, Enterprise 190 req/app/day, latest platforms 250 req/app/day

evidence.snippet: All APIs, whether legacy, new, or beta, use the same root path as before: https://api.hubapi.com/.
The webhooks API allows you to subscribe to events happening in a HubSpot account with your integration installed.
Free and Starter 100 / app (Any Hub) Enterprise 190 / app (Any Hub) Free, Starter, Professional, and Enterprise 250 / app
HubSpot offers two distinct MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — one for connecting any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent to your CRM
MCP server for HubSpot - CRM, Marketing, Sales and Service Hub integration

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free developer account with documented REST/GraphQL API and webhooks; app review required for production distribution.

overview_evidence.snippet: All of HubSpot's marketing, sales, and customer service software on one agentic platform.
Create tomorrow's solutions today on HubSpot's Developer Platform.
